trigger: Code-first review found that a keyboard-derived viewport ticket would be rejected after a structural rebuild solely because rebuilding native Buttons can clear direct keyboard focus before pre-draw.
why_the_first_shape_is_insufficient: Requiring the captured keyboard id to remain actively focused after mutation confuses mutation-caused native focus loss with a user supersession. That makes the structural-rebuild restore path incapable of preserving viewport contact for the exact keyboard fallback it claims to support.
corrective_plan: Keep accepted selection equality mandatory for a keyboard-derived ticket.
After mutation, accept either the same direct keyboard-focused semantic id or no direct keyboard focus; treat a different non-empty focused id as a real supersession and reject the ticket.
Add source-only regression fixtures for mutation-caused focus loss versus competing keyboard focus.
Propagate the corrected ownership law into viewport/native-UI skill doctrine and the existing warm-wall scar.
Do not infer TalkBack focus and do not claim runtime keyboard-focus preservation.
